video_title: Branden Carlson Media Availability | Oct. 2, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson credits Oklahoma City for his development and opportunity
quotes.excerpt: I have to give a shout out to OKC. I think they took a chance on me
quotes.quote: I mean there is a lot that went into it. I have to give a shout out to OKC. I think they took a chance on me and developed me. They put me in a good spot that my agent was able to go talk with teams. I think Portland as well, shout out to them for taking a chance on me. I was on a two-way for the past two years and so being able to come here, compete with these guys, and just having another opportunity to continue to showcase my game, I am just super grateful to them, to my agency, and everything that has put me in this place.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson is grateful for his opportunity with the Trail Blazers after spending the last two years on two-way contracts. He says he is ready to compete and showcase his game in Portland.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson feels comfortable playing both the four and five positions
quotes.excerpt: I am very confident in both positions.
quotes.quote: I have played five the majority of my whole life, but I think these past few years, my last year in college, I played a lot of four. And then as well just throughout here, I have been really working on it and so I am very confident in both positions.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson says he is very confident playing both the four and five positions as he looks to carve out a role in the Portland rotation.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson cites belief from Joe Cronin and Chauncey Billups
quotes.excerpt: Just the belief from Joe, from Coach Billups, it just felt right to me.
quotes.quote: Just the belief from Joe, from Coach Billups, it just felt right to me. And when we had to make a decision, it just felt right. With the lineup of guys that we had to play with, for me to be able to shine to make them look better, I just felt like it was a great opportunity all around for a whole organization and teammate standpoint.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson says the belief shown by Joe Cronin and Chauncey Billups made his decision to join the Trail Blazers feel right.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson describes his two-year mission in England
quotes.excerpt: I went on a mission, I was in England for two years.
quotes.quote: Right out of high school for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, I went on a mission, I was in England for two years. And so for those two years, I am just out there spreading the gospel of Jesus Christ, doing service, taking service opportunities where I can get them. I don't play basketball for those two years. From 2017 to 2019, I touched a basketball maybe a dozen times.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson reflects on his two-year mission in England after high school, noting he touched a basketball maybe a dozen times between 2017 and 2019.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson missed the competitiveness of basketball during his mission
quotes.excerpt: I just missed the competitiveness of it. I love I love just competing.
quotes.quote: I just missed the competitiveness of it. I love I love just competing. I think is the biggest part of it. It is just being able to go and have something to look forward to that drives me a little bit. Obviously, I just love the game. I love just playing. I love being around teammates and stuff that push other people who want to push you to make you better.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson says the biggest thing he missed during his two-year hiatus from basketball was the competitiveness of the game.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson praises the team culture and coaching in Portland
quotes.excerpt: The guys that we have with the coaches and players makes it easy.
quotes.quote: The guys that we have with the coaches and players makes it easy. I think we are obviously learning and always trying to get better, but I think it is just pretty smooth and simple to understand what is expected of us from the coaches and what our standards are supposed to be. And so it has just been easy to come out here and to feel a part of this bigger picture.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson praises the team culture in Portland, noting that it has been easy to understand the standards expected by the coaching staff.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson shares his top three comedy movie picks
quotes.excerpt: Step Brothers is probably one. I love Will Ferrell.
quotes.quote: Step Brothers is probably one. I love Will Ferrell. So two of my top three is Step Brothers and Get Hard. I love Dumb and Dumber. I love Talladega Nights is always good.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson reveals his top comedy movie picks, listing Step Brothers, Get Hard, Dumb and Dumber, and Talladega Nights.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson evaluates the personalities in the Trail Blazers locker room
quotes.excerpt: I think I am at the top, but Denny, Denny is a funny guy.
quotes.quote: I mean I think I am at the top, but Denny, Denny is a funny guy. Donovan is funny. Scoot, City. We got a lot of great personalities back in the locker room. It is too hard to tell, but I mean I am top tier though. Everyone else has to catch up with you.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson jokes that he is at the top of the list when it comes to the funniest personalities in the Trail Blazers locker room.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson discusses his golf outings with teammates
quotes.excerpt: I haven't gone with all three of them. I have gone with Mica.
quotes.quote: I haven't gone with all three of them. I have gone with Mica and he beat me that day. We went out to Pumpkin Ridge and I played terrible that day. And the other two I went golfing with twice DC and I won both of those ones. So we got to get all three of us out there.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson talks about his recent golf outings with teammates, noting he has been hitting the links with Mica and DC.

quotes.speaker: Branden Carlson
quotes.summary_phrase: Branden Carlson describes his playing style as a stretch big
quotes.excerpt: I am quite a bit more athletic than people give me credit for.
quotes.quote: I think a lot of people would say my strength is taking pop and being able to stretch the floor and then a little bit of rim protection. But I think a lot of people don't understand is how I am quite a bit more athletic than people give me credit for. So I think some Rip City fans are going to love some some good dunks from me. Obviously, no shade in or jaw, but I am a coach's player. I am a coach's player. So I would say that is good. And then I am just a team player who is going to do what is asked for whatever coach's role is for me this year.
quotes.social_post: Branden Carlson describes his game as a stretch big who can provide rim protection, adding that he is more athletic than people give him credit for.
